title: Titan Pro 15K Blue Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Blue Raspberry delivers the unmistakable sweet-tart flavour of ripe Blue Raspberry for a bright, punchy vape that stays clear and consistent throughout use. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack contains a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container, using a continuous auto-feed system to maintain steady coil saturation and flavour quality. Built with a 1.2ohm mesh coil, the pod produces smooth vapour and reliable MTL (mouth-to-lung) performance at 20mg Nic Salt strength. Designed exclusively for the Titan Pro 15K device, this system offers extended use and clean, satisfying flavour from start to finish. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
